title: Expressing Habitual Actions
subject: English Language
objectives: Answer questions about what people do regularly

blocks.caption: What do you do every day?

blocks.md: Habitual actions are things we do **every day** or regularly.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Jibril, what do you do every day?

lines.speaker: Jibril
lines.text: I water the plants every day.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Akpan, what does Jibril do every day?

lines.speaker: Akpan
lines.text: He waters the plants every day.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Ngozi, what do you do every day?

lines.speaker: Ngozi
lines.text: I visit my grandmother every day.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Jide, what does Ngozi do every day?

lines.speaker: Jide
lines.text: She visits her grandmother every day.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Kunle, what do the boys do every day after school?

lines.speaker: Kunle
lines.text: They play football every day after school.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Ayo, where does your father go every morning?

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: My father goes to his office every morning.

blocks.md: **Notice:** When we talk about he/she/it (third person), we add **'s'** to the verb (water -> waters, visit -> visits, go -> goes).

quiz.q: If you water the plants every day, you say:
options: I water the plants every day
quiz.explain: 'Every day' shows a habitual action in the present.

quiz.q: Jibril waters the plants. What does he do every day?
quiz.explain: For 'he', we add 's' to the verb (waters).

quiz.q: Ngozi visits her grandmother. What does she do every day?
quiz.explain: For 'she', we add 's' to the verb (visits).
